name: team-bridge
description: Connect this Claude Code session to a team room: list colleagues' sessions and message them (team_list_agents / team_send_message).

user.title: Your name
user.description: Shown to colleagues as part of your session name (letters/digits, e.g. alice). Defaults to your OS user name.

create_token.title: Room-creation token
create_token.description: Only needed if the hub gates room creation (CREATE_TOKEN). Leave empty otherwise.
